title: Reel Seattle Theater Registry
description: Canonical list of theaters supported by Reel Seattle. Authored in data/theaters.json and deployed as public/data/theaters.json.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this document shape (e.g. 1.0.0).

updated_at.description: Date the registry was last edited (ISO 8601 date).

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Never rename once showtimes reference it.

name.description: Canonical display name shown in the app and written to showtime records.

aliases.description: Alternate names from scrapers or historical data. Matched case-insensitively after trim.

source.description: Adapter that ingests this theater (amc, siff, beacon, etc.).

source_external_id.description: Vendor-specific ID (e.g. AMC API theatre id). Used for API calls; null until populated.

enabled.description: When false, scrapers and the processor should skip this theater. No code reads this field yet.

type.description: Venue category for UX and filtering.

city.description: Primary city for display and future map features.

neighborhood.description: Neighborhood or district within the city.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for showtime date interpretation.
